proposal.reason: Both experiments with the original policy and a revised policy (enabling quote refresh) achieved complete goal fulfillment, delivering all required items within budget and deadline. The original policy successfully navigated quote staleness through its refresh mechanism (triggered implicitly by quote expiration), and the revised policy confirmed that explicit refresh_before_order did not alter the outcome. No evidence of policy deficiency was observed.
